name: voc-curriculum-reform
description: A seven-role vocational curriculum reform team covering industry job research, BAG task extraction, six-table competency modelling, talent-training programme design, course standards, six-step lesson plans, interactive student courseware with simulation training, teaching-award portfolios and house-style Word/PDF delivery.

author.name: 李顺强（重庆现代制造职业学院·工业互联网应用专业）

displayDescription.en: Seven specialists cover job research, six-table modelling, talent-training programme design, course standards, 6x4 lesson plans, interactive student courseware with simulated drills, award portfolios and house-style Word/PDF delivery under one shared set of rules.
displayDescription.zh: 从岗位调研、六表建模到人培编排、课标教案、学生互动课件与仿真实训，七人分工一套口径，交付成套材料。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要修订工业互联网应用专业的人才培养方案，从岗位调研到六表、课标、教案全流程帮我编排。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I need to revise the talent-training programme for our Industrial Internet programme, end to end from job research to the six tables, course standards and lesson plans.

quickPrompts.en: I need to revise the talent-training programme for our Industrial Internet programme, end to end from job research to the six tables, course standards and lesson plans.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要修订工业互联网应用专业的人才培养方案，从岗位调研到六表、课标、教案全流程帮我编排。
按学院格式做一整套课改材料包：六表、人培方案、四门课标加教案，最后直接出 Word 和 PDF 交件。
quickPrompts.en: Build a full curriculum-reform package in our house style: six tables, talent-training programme, four course standards and lesson plans, then deliver final Word and PDF files.

quickPrompts.zh: 把 LF1—LF4 全部 11 个学习情境做成两件套：学生互动学习模块（预习＋游戏闯关＋仿真实训＋检测）和教师授课包，学生能自学、老师能直接上课。
quickPrompts.en: Build both pieces for all 11 learning situations of LF1-LF4: student interactive modules (preview, gamified levels, simulated drills, quizzes) and teacher lesson packages.
